package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type getPersonalTeacher interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}

type getTeacherSoul interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherSoul, error)
}

// PersonalTeacherHandler exposes administrative reads only.
type PersonalTeacherHandler struct {
	GetUC  getPersonalTeacher
	SoulUC getTeacherSoul
}

// GetSoulByStudentID returns the independently stored soul for one student's
// logical teacher without exposing learning state or dialog history.
func (handler PersonalTeacherHandler) GetSoulByStudentID(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"))
	if studentID == "" {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "student_id is required")
		return
	}
	soul, err := handler.SoulUC.Execute(r.Context(), studentID)
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, soul)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherSoulNotFound):
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
	default:
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to load teacher soul")
	}
}

// GetByStudentID returns the logical teacher assigned to a student.
func (handler PersonalTeacherHandler) GetByStudentID(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"))
	if studentID == "" {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "student_id is required")
		return
	}
	teacher, err := handler.GetUC.Execute(r.Context(), studentID)
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teacher)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrPersonalTeacherNotFound):
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
	default:
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to load personal teacher")
	}
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, value any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, message string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{"error": message})
}
